map.τ = R × C，计算 RC 电路充放电时间常数与电压曲线: Compute the RC time constant τ = R×C and the time to charge or discharge to a chosen percentage for filter and delay design.
map.时间常数由电阻 R 与电容 C 的乘积决定（单位：Ω·F = s）。: The time constant is the product of resistance R and capacitance C (unit: Ω·F = s).
map.一阶 RC 电路充放电电压随时间的指数变化；约 5τ 后达到终值的 99.3%。: A first-order RC circuit's charge/discharge voltage changes exponentially with time; after about 5τ it reaches 99.3% of the final value.
map.充电：V(t)=Vs×(1−e^(−t/τ))；放电：V(t)=V0×e^(−t: Charge: V(t)=Vs×(1−e^(−t/τ)); discharge: V(t)=V0×e^(−t/τ). After about 5τ it is effectively complete (>99%).

map.设计 RC 滤波、延时或按键去抖电路。: Design RC filters, delays or button-debounce circuits.
map.R=1 kΩ、C=100 µF → τ=RC=0.1 s；充电到 63.2% 需: R=1 kΩ, C=100 µF → τ=RC=0.1 s; reaching 63.2% takes 1τ, 95% about 3τ.
map.电压升至终值的 63.2% 所需时间。: The time for the voltage to rise to 63.2% of its final value.
map.RC 时间常数计算根据电阻与电容值计算时间常数 τ、各时间点充放电电压与截止频率: The RC Time Constant Calculator computes τ, the charge/discharge voltage at each time point and the cutoff frequency from R and C. It is a basic tool for transient analysis and filter design, runs fully in the browser and uploads no data.
map.RC 时间常数（本页代码口径，单位先折算）：R=阻值×单位倍率（Ω×1/kΩ×1: RC time constant (per this page's code, units converted first): R=resistance×unit multiplier (Ω×1/kΩ×1000/MΩ×10⁶), C=capacitance×unit multiplier (μF×10⁻⁶/nF×10⁻⁹/pF×10⁻¹²/F×1); τ=R×C (seconds); key points reach 63.2% (1τ)/86.5% (2τ)/95% (3τ)/98.2% (4τ)/99.3% (5τ), with 5τ≈fully charged. Validation: when R≤0 or C≤0, τ shows "—" and prompts "Please enter valid R and C"; the supply voltage defaults to 5 V. Grading: no fixed tiers; the larger τ is, the slower the charge and discharge.
map.到达阈值时间判读（与上式互补）：充电到 α% 所需 t=−τ×ln(1−α÷10: Time to reach a threshold (complementary to the formula above): charging to α% takes t=−τ×ln(1−α÷100) (solved back from Vs×(1−e^(−t÷τ))=α%×Vs); the 10%→90% rise time=τ×ln9≈2.2τ; discharging to α% gives t=−τ×ln(α÷100). Validation: shares the R and C validity check above. Grading: no fixed tiers; after each τ the remaining charging distance compresses to 1÷e≈36.8% of the original.
